title: Knowledge Conflicts for LLMs: A Survey
best_for_zh: 关注检索增强、事实可靠性和矛盾证据处理的读者。
one_line: An EMNLP 2024 survey of conflicts between contextual and parametric knowledge in LLMs.
系统梳理大语言模型中上下文知识与参数知识发生冲突的情形。
why: It makes disagreement between a prompt and a model's learned knowledge explicit and comparable.
inclusion_reason: An EMNLP survey that gives readers a usable map of conflicting knowledge sources in LLM behavior.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLMs may face a prompt that disagrees with what they learned or contains mutually inconsistent statements. This EMNLP 2024 survey defines the problem through context-memory, inter-context, and intra-memory conflicts, and explains why noisy information can harm reliability.

Disagreement is not automatically a model error. A task must state which source should govern the response and whether uncertainty should be exposed. Without that rule, conflicting evidence, outdated information, and an unclear instruction about authority can be mistaken for the same factuality failure.

大语言模型可能遇到与其已学知识矛盾的提示，也可能面对彼此不一致的上下文。EMNLP 2024 的这篇综述把问题分为上下文—记忆、上下文之间、记忆内部三类冲突，并说明噪声信息为何会损害可靠性。

信息不一致并不自动等于模型出错。任务需要说明哪一种来源应决定回答，以及是否应暴露不确定性。没有这条规则时，相互矛盾的证据、过时信息和不清楚的权威指令，会被误认为同一种事实性失败。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is to distinguish where disagreement occurs before comparing solutions. The survey connects each conflict category to its causes, observed LLM behavior, and proposed remedies, so a reader can ask whether a failure comes from supplied context, competing sources, or stored knowledge.

This prevents remedies from being treated as interchangeable. A strategy for contradictory documents may not address a mismatch between a document and learned knowledge, while internal inconsistency raises a different question. Identify the sources present, their relationship, and the response behavior the evaluation rewards before judging a method.

核心思路是先分清分歧发生在何处，再比较解决方法。综述把每类冲突联系到成因、模型表现和已有应对方式，读者可以据此判断失败来自给定上下文、相互竞争的信息源，还是模型内部知识。

这避免把不同应对方式看成可以互换。处理矛盾文档的策略未必能解决文档与已学知识的不一致，而内部不一致又提出另一类问题。评价方法前，应识别现有来源、它们的关系，以及评测奖励什么回答行为。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature synthesis, not a new training method. It classifies knowledge conflicts, examines their causes and model behaviors, and reviews solutions; the relevant inputs are contextual statements and model knowledge, while the output is a response under disagreement.
这是一篇文献综述，不是新的训练方法。它分类知识冲突、讨论其成因和模型行为，并回顾解决方案；相关输入是上下文陈述与模型已学知识，输出是在分歧条件下给出的回答。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Its evidence is a structured account of existing studies rather than a new benchmark result. The official abstract explicitly identifies the three conflict categories and states that the paper reviews causes, behaviors, and available solutions; compare cited results only with their original settings in view.
它的证据是对已有研究的结构化整理，而非新的基准分数。官方摘要明确给出三类冲突，并说明论文回顾成因、行为和可用方案；比较被引用结果时，应同时查看原论文的具体设置。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Instead of treating every factual error alike, the paper makes the source of conflict a first-class comparison unit. Its contribution is a common vocabulary spanning contextual and parametric knowledge, not a new model or dataset.
论文不把所有事实错误混为一谈，而是把冲突来源作为比较的基本单位。它的贡献是一套同时覆盖上下文知识与参数知识的共同语言，而不是发布新模型或新数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The reviewed studies need not share models, prompts, evidence sources, or outcome definitions, so their numbers are not automatically comparable. A conflict may also be underspecified: the right response depends on which source a task treats as authoritative.

This is why source priority must be written down, rather than inferred afterward from a preferred answer.

被整理的研究未必使用相同模型、提示、证据来源或结果定义，因此分数不能直接横比。冲突本身也可能缺少明确规范：正确回答取决于任务把哪一种信息源视为依据。

因此应预先写下来源优先级，而不要事后从偏好的答案中倒推。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this survey when a system combines retrieval, documents, or user-provided context with model knowledge. It helps turn a vague concern about factuality into a testable question: which knowledge sources disagree, and which behavior is desired?

Use the answer to specify test cases before comparing systems. State the conflicting sources and the intended authority rule, then check whether the evaluation measures that behavior rather than only surface agreement.

当系统把检索结果、文档或用户提供的上下文与模型知识结合时，可用这篇综述。它能把模糊的事实性担忧变成可检验的问题：哪些知识源在冲突，希望模型采取什么行为？

可据此在比较系统前规定测试：写明冲突来源和预期权威规则，再检查评测是否测到了该行为，而不只是测表面一致。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
When turning the survey into an evaluation plan, keep the construction visible. State whether context is intended to override learned knowledge, whether contextual statements conflict with one another, and whether the response should choose, explain, defer, or express uncertainty. Change one condition at a time. This reveals whether a result concerns source selection, conflict recognition, or answer form. It also avoids rewarding a system merely for repeating the latest statement when the task requires comparison of evidence. The categories are most useful as a disciplined separation of cases, not as a broad name for every incorrect answer.

Read the three categories first, then follow the discussion of causes, behaviors, and solutions. For each cited method, record what knowledge source is varied and what response counts as correct; this prevents a robustness claim from becoming too broad.

For a deeper reading, construct a small conflict record for every example. Write down the contextual statement, the model knowledge that may disagree with it, whether competing context sources also disagree, and the authority rule used to define a correct response. This record distinguishes context-memory conflict from inter-context and intra-memory conflict before a method is judged. It also reveals whether a reported improvement changes the model's use of supplied information, changes the source that is treated as authoritative, or changes only the evaluation setting. Do not transfer a result until the target system has comparable sources and a comparably stated authority rule. The survey is valuable because it makes this hidden structure legible.

若要把综述转化为评测计划，应让冲突构造保持可见：说明上下文是否应覆盖已学知识、上下文陈述是否互相矛盾，以及回答是应选择、解释、暂缓还是表达不确定性。每次只改变一个条件，才能看出结果涉及来源选择、冲突识别还是回答形式。这也避免仅因系统复述最新一句话就给予奖励，而任务实际要求比较证据。分类最适合用来有纪律地拆分情形，而不是泛称一切错误答案。

建议先读三类冲突，再看成因、行为和解决方案。阅读每个被引用方法时，记下改变的是哪种知识源、什么回答算正确；这样能避免把“鲁棒性”理解得过于宽泛。

若想读得更深入，可为每个例子建立一条小型冲突记录：写下上下文陈述、可能与其矛盾的模型知识、不同上下文来源是否彼此冲突，以及任务用什么权威规则来定义正确回答。这样可在评价方法前先区分上下文—记忆、上下文之间和记忆内部的冲突。它还会暴露所谓提升究竟改变了模型使用给定信息的方式、改变了被视为依据的来源，还是只改变了评价设置。只有目标系统具有可比的信息源和同样明确的权威规则时，才适合迁移结果；综述的价值正是让这种隐藏结构变得可见。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Rongwu Xu, Zehan Qi, Zhijiang Guo, Cunxiang Wang, Hongru Wang, Yue Zhang, and Wei Xu. 2024. Knowledge Conflicts for LLMs: A Survey. EMNLP 2024, pages 8541–8565. https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.486/

The ACL Anthology record supplies the bibliographic entry and abstract. Use the survey to identify the conflict type, then follow its cited primary study for the exact prompt construction, source material, response policy, and metric. Those details determine whether a reported result applies to a system with different documents or model knowledge.

Keep the primary study's authority assumptions with every extracted result.

Rongwu Xu、Zehan Qi、Zhijiang Guo 等。2024。《Knowledge Conflicts for LLMs: A Survey》。EMNLP 2024，8541–8565 页。https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.486/

ACL Anthology 页面提供书目信息和摘要。可先借综述确定冲突类型，再追溯其引用的原始研究，查看确切提示构造、信息来源、回答规则和指标。这些细节决定结果能否用于具有不同文档或模型知识的系统。

摘录结果时，应同时保留原始研究对权威来源的假设。
